INFO.HERO_DESC: A place of devotion, seva and the centuries-old Nagdwar Vari tradition.
INFO.ABOUT_P1: Shri Sant Maroti Maharaj Sevashram at Shri Kshetra Salbardi is dedicated to the memory and teachings of Shri Sant Maroti Maharaj. The Sevashram is managed by a Board of Trustees and serves devotees through worship, spiritual programs and social activities.
INFO.ABOUT_P2: The Nagdwar Vari of Shri Sant Maroti Maharaj began in 1880 CE and continues uninterrupted to this day. Maharaj himself completed 85 Varis; afterwards, through the experiences of devotees, the tradition reached thousands upon thousands of bhaktas. In 2025 the Sevashram celebrated the Suvarna Mahotsav (golden jubilee) marking Maharaj's 50th Punyatithi.

PROGRAMS.PUNYATITHI_DESC: Annual remembrance of Shri Sant Maroti Maharaj. The 50th Punyatithi (7 December 2025) featured an art exhibition, rangoli exhibition and a women's bhajan competition.
PROGRAMS.NAGDWAR_DESC: The pilgrimage from Salbardi to Nagdwar (Pachmarhi), started in 1880 CE, concluding with the Mavand Mahaprasad at Salbardi.
PROGRAMS.PARAYAN_DESC: Collective reading and recitation of the Shri Dnyaneshwari by devotees.
PROGRAMS.BAL_SANSKAR_DESC: Camp to teach children values, prayers and culture.
PROGRAMS.MAHILA_DESC: Annual gathering of women devotees, with bhajans and programs.
PROGRAMS.TREE_DESC: Tree plantation drives (vruksharopan) around the Sevashram.
